en_question: A data engineer wants to orchestrate a set of extract, transform, and load (ETL) jobs that run on AWS. The ETL jobs contain tasks that must run Apache Spark jobs on Amazon EMR, make API calls to Salesforce, and load data into Amazon Redshift. The ETL jobs need to handle failures and retries automatically. The data engineer needs to use Python to orchestrate the jobs. Which service will meet these requirements?

en_options.A: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA)
en_options.B: AWS Step Functions
en_options.C: AWS Glue
en_options.D: Amazon EventBridge

zh_question: 一位資料工程師想要協調一組在AWS上執行的提取、轉換和載入(ETL)作業。 這些ETL作業包含必須在AmazonEMR上執行ApacheSpark作業、向 Salesforce發出API呼叫，以及將資料載入到AmazonRedshift的任務。 ETL作業需要自動處理失敗與重試。資料工程師需要使用Python來協調 這些作業。 哪項服務符合這些需求？

en_question: A data engineer maintains custom Python scripts that perform a data formatting process that many AWS Lambda functions use. When the data engineer needs to modify the Python scripts, the data engineer must manually update all the Lambda functions. The data engineer requires a less manual way to update the Lambda functions. Which solution will meet this requirement?

en_options.A: Store the custom Python scripts in a shared Amazon S3 bucket. Store a pointer to the custom scripts in the execution context object.
en_options.B: Package the custom Python scripts into Lambda layers. Apply the Lambda layers to the Lambda functions.
en_options.C: Store the custom Python scripts in a shared Amazon S3 bucket. Store a pointer to the customer scripts in environment variables.
en_options.D: Assign the same alias to each Lambda function. Call each Lambda function by specifying the function's alias.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師維護自訂的Python腳本，這些腳本執行許多AWSLambda函 式所使用的資料格式化流程。當該資料工程師需要修改這些腳本時，必須手動更 新所有相關的函式。 資料工程師需要一種較少手動操作的方式來更新Lambda函式。 哪種解決方案能符合此需求？

en_question: A company stores customer data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Multiple teams in the company want to use the customer data for downstream analysis. The company needs to ensure that the teams do not have access to personally identifiable information (PII) about the customers. Which solution will meet this requirement with LEAST operational overhead?

en_options.A: Use Amazon Macie to create and run a sensitive data discovery job to detect and remove PII.
en_options.B: Use S3 Object Lambda to access the data, and use Amazon Comprehend to detect and remove PII.
en_options.C: Use Amazon Data Firehose and Amazon Comprehend to detect and remove PII.
en_options.D: Use an AWS Glue DataBrew job to store the PII data in a second S3 bucket. Perform analysis on the data that remains in the original S3 bucket.

zh_question: 一家公司將客戶資料儲存在AmazonS3儲存桶中。公司內的多個團隊希望使用這 些客戶資料進行下游分析。該公司需要確保這些團隊無法存取關於客戶的個人識 別資訊（PII）。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足此需求？

en_question: A company stores its processed data in an S3 bucket. The company has a strict data access policy. The company uses IAM roles to grant teams within the company different levels of access to the S3 bucket. The company wants to receive notifications when a user violates the data access policy. Each notification must include the username of the user who violated the policy. Which solution will meet these requirements?

en_options.A: Use AWS Config rules to detect violations of the data access policy. Set up compliance alarms.
en_options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to gather object-level metrics. Set up CloudWatch alarms.
en_options.C: Use AWS CloudTrail to track object-level events for the S3 bucket. Forward events to Amazon CloudWatch to set up CloudWatch alarms.
en_options.D: Use Amazon S3 server access logs to monitor access to the bucket. Forward the access logs to an Amazon CloudWatch log group. Use metric filters on the log group to set up CloudWatch alarms.

zh_question: 一家公司將其處理後的資料儲存在S3儲存貯體中。該公司有嚴格的資料存取政 策，並使用IAM角色授予公司內不同團隊對該S3儲存貯體的各級存取權限。 該公司希望在使用者違反資料存取政策時收到通知。每則通知必須包含違反 政策的使用者名稱。 哪項解決方案符合這些需求？

en_question: A company needs to load customer data that comes from a third party into an Amazon Redshift data warehouse. The company stores order data and product data in the same data warehouse. The company wants to use the combined dataset to identify potential new customers. A data engineer notices that one of the fields in the source data includes values that are in JSON format. How should the data engineer load the JSON data into the data warehouse with the LEAST effort?

en_options.A: Use the SUPER data type to store the data in the Amazon Redshift table.
en_options.B: Use AWS Glue to flatten the JSON data and ingest it into the Amazon Redshift table.
en_options.C: Use Amazon S3 to store the JSON data. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
en_options.D: Use an AWS Lambda function to flatten the JSON data. Store the data in Amazon S3.

zh_question: 一家公司需要將來自第三方的客戶資料載入AmazonRedshift資料倉儲。該公 司將訂單資料和產品資料儲存在同一個資料倉儲中。該公司希望使用合併後的資 料集來識別潛在的新客戶。 一位資料工程師注意到來源資料中的其中一個欄位包含採用JSON格式的值。 資料工程師應如何以最少的努力將此JSON資料載入資料倉儲？

en_question: A company wants to analyze sales records that the company stores in a MySQL database. The company wants to correlate the records with sales opportunities identified by Salesforce. The company receives 2 GB of sales records every day. The company has 100 GB of identified sales opportunities. A data engineer needs to develop a process that will analyze and correlate sales records and sales opportunities. The process must run once each night. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

en_options.A: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to fetch both datasets. Use AWS Lambda functions to correlate the datasets. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the process.
en_options.B: Use Amazon AppFlow to fetch sales opportunities from Salesforce. Use AWS Glue to fetch sales records from the MySQL database. Correlate the sales records with the sales opportunities. Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to orchestrate the process.
en_options.C: Use Amazon AppFlow to fetch sales opportunities from Salesforce. Use AWS Glue to fetch sales records from the MySQL database. Correlate the sales records with sales opportunities. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the process.
en_options.D: Use Amazon AppFlow to fetch sales opportunities from Salesforce. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to fetch sales records from the MySQL database. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to correlate the datasets. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the process.

zh_question: 一家公司想要分析儲存在MySQL資料庫中的銷售記錄。該公司希望將這些記錄 與Salesforce識別出的銷售機會進行關聯。 該公司每天收到2GB的銷售記錄，並擁有100GB已識別的銷售機會。資料工程 師需要開發一個流程，以分析並關聯銷售記錄與銷售機會。此流程必須每晚執行 一次。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

en_question: A company stores server logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to keep the logs for 1 year. The logs are not required after 1 year. A data engineer needs a solution to automatically delete logs that are older than 1 year. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

en_options.A: Define an S3 Lifecycle configuration to delete the logs after 1 year.
en_options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function to delete the logs after 1 year.
en_options.C: Schedule a cron job on an Amazon EC2 instance to delete the logs after 1 year.
en_options.D: Configure an AWS Step Functions state machine to delete the logs after 1 year.

zh_question: 一家公司將伺服器日誌儲存在AmazonS3儲存桶中。該公司需要保留這些日 誌1年，且1年後不再需要這些日誌。 資料工程師需要一種解決方案，以自動刪除超過1年的日誌。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

en_question: A company is designing a serverless data processing workflow in AWS Step Functions that involves multiple steps. The processing workflow ingests data from an external API, transforms the data by using multiple AWS Lambda functions, and loads the transformed data into Amazon DynamoDB. The company needs the workflow to perform specific steps based on the content of the incoming data. Which Step Functions state type should the company use to meet this requirement?

en_options.A: Parallel
en_options.B: Choice
en_options.C: Task
en_options.D: Map

zh_question: 一家公司正在設計一個涉及多個步驟的無伺服器資料處理工作流程，該工作流 程使用AWSStepFunctions。此處理工作流程從外部API擷取資料，使用多 個AWSLambda函數轉換資料，並將轉換後的資料載入至Amazon DynamoDB。 該公司需要工作流程根據傳入資料的內容執行特定步驟。 為了符合此需求，該公司應使用哪一種StepFunctions狀態類型？

en_question: A data engineer created a table named cloudtrail_logs in Amazon Athena to query AWS CloudTrail logs and prepare data for audits. The data engineer needs to write a query to display errors with error codes that have occurred since the beginning of 2024. The query must return the 10 most recent errors. Which query will meet these requirements?

en_options.A: select count (*) as TotalEvents, eventname, errorcode, errormessage from cloudtrail_logswhere errorcode is not nulland eventtime >= '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z' group by eventname, errorcode, errormessageorder by TotalEvents desclimit 10;
en_options.B: select count (*) as TotalEvents, eventname, errorcode, errormessage from cloudtrail_logs where eventtime >= '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z' group by eventname, errorcode, errormessage order by TotalEvents desc limit 10;
en_options.C: select count (*) as TotalEvents, eventname, errorcode, errormessage from cloudtrail_logswhere eventtime >= '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z' group by eventname, errorcode, errormessageorder by eventname asc limit 10;
en_options.D: select count (*) as TotalEvents, eventname, errorcode, errormessage from cloudtrail_logs where errorcode is not nulland eventtime >= '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z' group by eventname, errorcode, errormessagelimit 10;

zh_question: 一名資料工程師在AmazonAthena中建立了一個名為cloudtrail_logs的資料 表，用於查詢AWSCloudTrail日誌並為審計準備資料。該資料工程師需要編寫 一個查詢，以顯示自2024年初以來發生的帶有錯誤碼的錯誤。該查詢必須傳回最 近的10個錯誤。 哪個查詢符合這些需求？

en_question: An online retailer uses multiple delivery partners to deliver products to customers. The delivery partners send order summaries to the retailer. The retailer stores the order summaries in Amazon S3. Some of the order summaries contain personally identifiable information (PII) about customers. A data engineer needs to detect PII in the order summaries so the company can redact the PII. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

en_options.A: Amazon Textract
en_options.B: Amazon S3 Storage Lens
en_options.C: Amazon Macie
en_options.D: Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler

zh_question: 一家線上零售商使用多個配送合作夥伴將產品送達客戶。配送合作夥伴會將 訂單摘要傳送給零售商。零售商將這些訂單摘要儲存在AmazonS3中。 部分訂單摘要包含客戶的個人識別資訊(PII)。資料工程師需要偵測訂單摘要中的 PII，以便公司將其塗銷。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔符合這些需求？

en_question: A company has an Amazon Redshift data warehouse that users access by using a variety of IAM roles. More than 100 users access the data warehouse every day. The company wants to control user access to the objects based on each user's job role, permissions, and how sensitive the data is. Which solution will meet these requirements?

en_options.A: Use the role-based access control (RBAC) feature of Amazon Redshift.
en_options.B: Use the row-level security (RLS) feature of Amazon Redshift.
en_options.C: Use the column-level security (CLS) feature of Amazon Redshift.
en_options.D: Use dynamic data masking policies in Amazon Redshift.

zh_question: 一家公司擁有一個AmazonRedshift資料倉儲，使用者透過多種IAM角色進 行存取。每天有超過100位使用者存取該資料倉儲。 公司希望根據每位使用者的職務角色、權限以及資料的敏感程度，控制使用者對 物件的存取。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

en_question: A company uses Amazon DataZone as a data governance and business catalog solution. The company stores data in an Amazon S3 data lake. The company uses AWS Glue with an AWS Glue Data Catalog. A data engineer needs to publish AWS Glue Data Quality scores to the Amazon DataZone portal. Which solution will meet this requirement?

en_options.A: Create a data quality ruleset with Data Quality Definition language (DQDL) rules that apply to a specific AWS Glue table. Schedule the ruleset to run daily. Configure the Amazon DataZone project to have an Amazon Redshift data source. Enable the data quality configuration for the data source.
en_options.B: Configure AWS Glue ETL jobs to use an Evaluate Data Quality transform. Define a data quality ruleset inside the jobs. Configure the Amazon DataZone project to have an AWS Glue data source. Enable the data quality configuration for the data source.
en_options.C: Create a data quality ruleset with Data Quality Definition language (DQDL) rules that apply to a specific AWS Glue table. Schedule the ruleset to run daily. Configure the Amazon DataZone project to have an AWS Glue data source. Enable the data quality configuration for the data source.
en_options.D: Configure AWS Glue ETL jobs to use an Evaluate Data Quality transform. Define a data quality ruleset inside the jobs. Configure the Amazon DataZone project to have an Amazon Redshift data source. Enable the data quality configuration for the data source.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonDataZone作為資料治理和業務目錄解決方案。該公司 將資料儲存在AmazonS3資料湖中，並使用AWSGlue搭配AWSGlue資料 目錄。 資料工程師需要將AWSGlue資料品質分數發布至AmazonDataZone入口網 站。 哪項解決方案能符合此需求？

en_question: A company has a data warehouse in Amazon Redshift. To comply with security regulations, the company needs to log and store all user activities and connection activities for the data warehouse. Which solution will meet these requirements?

en_options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable logging for the Amazon Redshift cluster. Specify the S3 bucket in the logging configuration to store the logs.
en_options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Enable logging for the Amazon Redshift cluster. Write logs to the EFS file system.
en_options.C: Create an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. Enable logging for the Amazon Redshift cluster. Write the logs to a table in the Aurora MySQL database.
en_options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Enable logging for the Amazon Redshift cluster. Write the logs to the EBS volume.

zh_question: 一家公司在AmazonRedshift中擁有資料倉儲。為了符合安全法規，該公司需 要記錄並儲存該資料倉儲的所有使用者活動與連線活動。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

en_question: A company wants to migrate a data warehouse from Teradata to Amazon Redshift. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

en_options.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to migrate the schema. Use AWS DMS to migrate the data.
en_options.B: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the schema. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the data.
en_options.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the data. Use automatic schema conversion.
en_options.D: Manually export the schema definition from Teradata. Apply the schema to the Amazon Redshift database. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the data.

zh_question: 一家公司希望將資料倉儲從Teradata遷移至AmazonRedshift。 哪種解決方案能以最小的營運工作量滿足此需求？

en_question: A company uses a variety of AWS and third-party data stores. The company wants to consolidate all the data into a central data warehouse to perform analytics. Users need fast response times for analytics queries. The company uses Amazon QuickSight in direct query mode to visualize the data. Users normally run queries during a few hours each day with unpredictable spikes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

en_options.A: Use Amazon Redshift Serverless to load all the data into Amazon Redshift managed storage (RMS).
en_options.B: Use Amazon Athena to load all the data into Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format.
en_options.C: Use Amazon Redshift provisioned clusters to load all the data into Amazon Redshift managed storage (RMS).
en_options.D: Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL to load all the data into Aurora.

zh_question: 一家公司使用多種AWS及第三方資料儲存區。該公司希望將所有資料整合 至中央資料倉儲以執行分析。使用者需要針對分析查詢獲得快速的回應時間。 該公司使用AmazonQuickSight的直接查詢模式來視覺化資料。使用者通 常每天在數小時內執行查詢，且會出現不可預測的尖峰。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

en_question: A data engineer uses Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest and process records that contain user behavior data from an application every day. The data engineer notices that the data stream is experiencing throttling because hot shards receive much more data than other shards in the data stream. How should the data engineer resolve the throttling issue?

en_options.A: Use a random partition key to distribute the ingested records.
en_options.B: Increase the number of shards in the data stream. Distribute the records across the shards.
en_options.C: Limit the number of records that are sent each second by the producer to match the capacity of the stream.
en_options.D: Decrease the size of the records that the producer sends to match the capacity of the stream.

zh_question: 一名資料工程師使用AmazonKinesisDataStreams每日攝取並處理包 含應用程式使用者行為資料的記錄。 該資料工程師注意到，由於熱點分片接收的資料量遠高於資料串流中的其他 分片，導致資料串流發生節流現象。 資料工程師應如何解決此節流問題？

en_question: A company has a data processing pipeline that includes several dozen steps. The data processing pipeline needs to send alerts in real time when a step fails or succeeds. The data processing pipeline uses a combination of Amazon S3 buckets, AWS Lambda functions, and AWS Step Functions state machines. A data engineer needs to create a solution to monitor the entire pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements?

en_options.A: Configure the Step Functions state machines to store notifications in an Amazon S3 bucket when the state machines finish running. Enable S3 event notifications on the S3 bucket.
en_options.B: Configure the AWS Lambda functions to store notifications in an Amazon S3 bucket when the state machines finish running. Enable S3 event notifications on the S3 bucket.
en_options.C: Use AWS CloudTrail to send a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that sends notifications when a state machine fails to run or succeeds to run.
en_options.D: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to react when the execution status of a state machine changes. Configure the rule to send a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that sends notifications.

zh_question: 一家公司擁有一個包含數十個步驟的資料處理管線。該資料處理管線需要在任何 步驟失敗或成功時即時發送警報。此資料處理管線結合使用了AmazonS3儲存 桶、AWSLambda函數以及AWSStepFunctions狀態機器。 一位資料工程師需要建立一個解決方案，以監控整個管線。 哪種解決方案能符合這些需求？

en_question: A company has an application that uses an Amazon API Gateway REST API and an AWS Lambda function to retrieve data from an Amazon DynamoDB instance. Users recently reported intermittent high latency in the application's response times. A data engineer finds that the Lambda function experiences frequent throttling when the company's other Lambda functions experience increased invocations. The company wants to ensure the API's Lambda function operate without being affected by other Lambda functions. Which solution will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

en_options.A: Increase the number of read capacity unit (RCU) in DynamoDB.
en_options.B: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function.
en_options.C: Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda function.
en_options.D: Increase the Lambda function timeout and allocated memory.

zh_question: 一家公司擁有一個應用程式，該應用程式使用AmazonAPIGatewayREST API和AWSLambda函數從AmazonDynamoDB執行個體擷取資料。使用者 最近回報應用程式的回應時間出現間歇性的高延遲。一位資料工程師發現，當該 公司的其他Lambda函數經歷呼叫次數增加時，此Lambda函數會頻繁遭遇節 流。 該公司希望確保此API的Lambda函數運作時不受其他Lambda函數影響。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足此需求？

en_question: A company has as JSON file that contains personally identifiable information (PII) data and non-PII data. The company needs to make the data available for querying and analysis. The non-PII data must be available to everyone in the company. The PII data must be available only to a limited group of employees. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

en_options.A: Store the JSON file in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure AWS Glue to split the file into one file that contains the PII data and one file that contains the non-PII data. Store the output files in separate S3 buckets. Grant the required access to the buckets based on the type of user.
en_options.B: Store the JSON file in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to identify PII data and to grant access based on the type of user.
en_options.C: Store the JSON file in an Amazon S3 bucket. Catalog the file schema in AWS Lake Formation. Use Lake Formation permissions to provide access to the required data based on the type of user.
en_options.D: Create two Amazon RDS PostgreSQL databases. Load the PII data and the non-PII data into the separate databases. Grant access to the databases based on the type of user.

zh_question: 某公司擁有一個包含個人識別資訊(PII)資料與非PII資料的JSON檔案。該公 司需要讓這些資料可供查詢與分析。 非個人識別資訊（PII）資料必須提供給公司內的所有人。個人識別資訊（ PII）資料則僅限於特定群組的員工存取。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

en_question: A company uses AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt an Amazon Redshift cluster. The company wants to configure a cross-Region snapshot of the Redshift cluster as part of disaster recovery (DR) strategy. A data engineer needs to use the AWS CLI to create the cross-Region snapshot. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

en_options.A: Create a KMS key and configure a snapshot copy grant in the source AWS Region.
en_options.B: In the source AWS Region, enable snapshot copying. Specify the name of the snapshot copy grant that is created in the destination AWS Region.
en_options.C: In the source AWS Region, enable snapshot copying. Specify the name of the snapshot copy grant that is created in the source AWS Region.
en_options.D: Create a KMS key and configure a snapshot copy grant in the destination AWS Region.
en_options.E: Convert the cluster to a Multi-AZ deployment.

zh_question: 一家公司使用AWSKeyManagementService(AWSKMS)來加密Amazon Redshift叢集。該公司希望設定跨區域的Redshift叢集快照，作為其災難復原 (DR)策略的一部分。 資料工程師需要使用AWSCLI來建立跨區域的快照。 哪兩個步驟的組合符合這些需求？（請選擇兩項。）

en_question: A company is using Amazon S3 to build a data lake. The company needs to replicate records from multiple source databases into Apache Parquet format. Most of the source databases are hosted on Amazon RDS. However, one source database is an on-premises Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise instance. The company needs to implement a solution to replicate existing data from all source databases and all future changes to the target S3 data lake. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

en_options.A: Use one AWS Glue job to replicate existing data. Use a second AWS Glue job to replicate future changes.
en_options.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replicate existing data. Use AWS Glue jobs to replicate future changes.
